title: bidens cronquistii
intro: Bidens cronquistii, commonly known as a flowering plant species in the daisy family, is native to the mountainous regions of Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cold, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Bidens cronquistii include its ability to act as an antipyretic, analgesic, and expectorant, making it a potential natural remedy for conditions like bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include sesquiterpenoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which have been identified through phytochemical analysis.
